title: R2 fix: remove dead pub_key in test_ecdsa_roundtrip
description: In crypto2dev_test.c test_ecdsa_roundtrip(): pub_key is declared, initialized with wc_ecc_init_ex, and freed, but never populated with key material or used in any cryptographic operation. The actual verify uses verify_key (a separate local). pub_key is pure dead code, violating the no-dead-code project rule. Remove declaration, init, and free.
